# Scoped Instructions: `.github/workflows`

Inherit `.github/AGENTS.md` and the root contract.

Before changing a workflow, identify trigger, trust level, permissions, secrets, checkout mode, network
destinations, artifacts, and release authority. Add a dedicated issue and evals for positive, negative,
fork, retry, and failure paths.

Issue #34 does not authorize workflow YAML changes. A documentation worker may edit only this guide.
